name: invoices-and-quotes
description: Search, inspect, and prepare numbered invoice drafts and quote drafts, or delete/cancel quotes in a connected Frihet workspace. Use when the user asks to list, search, or read invoices or quotes, check draft or overdue invoices, prepare or create an invoice or quote draft, or delete/cancel a quote (facturas, presupuestos, borradores de factura, buscar facturas).
